commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton).

90+3' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
90+3' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) replaces Joao Gomes.
89' The substitution is prepared. Angel Gomes (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hee-Chan Hwang.
88' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood will be replaced by Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton).
88' Substitution. Solly March (Brighton) in, Maxim De Cuyper out.
86' 3 - 0 Goal! Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 3:0.
85' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
81' Dangerous play by Yerson Mosquera (Wolves). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
78' The corner kick from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
78' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
76' Today's match ends for Carlos Baleba who will be replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
76' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Danny Welbeck is replaced by Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
75' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
75' Joel Veltman (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
75' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Toti (Wolves) and blew his whistle.
74' Brighton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' What was Andre (Wolves) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Pedro Lima and he is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
67' Substitution. Mateus Mane makes his way off the pitch and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) comes on as his replacement.
67' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle.
64' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Daniel Bentley stops the ball from going inside right post.
64' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is able to continue to play.
62' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

60' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
58' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make a change. Kaoru Mitoma is unable to continue due to injury, Joel Veltman (Brighton) comes on.
56' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) picks up an injury.
56' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
53' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
53' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Pedro Lima (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Wolves.
49' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
49' CHANCE! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Daniel Bentley, who produces an excellent reflex save.
47' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Rob Edwards probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Hugo Bueno. He is replaced by David Moller Wolfe (Wolves).
46' Referee John Brooks blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
38' Some great controlled play and passing from Brighton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Mateus Mane (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
35' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) takes the corner.
34' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
33' A cross from Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
33' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Brighton are taking a throw-in.
31' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
29' A pass from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is intercepted by Daniel Bentley and the move breaks down.
26' Pascal Gross (Brighton) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolves.
25' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
24' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a yellow card!
23' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee John Brooks who sees an offensive foul.
21' Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

21' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Daniel Bentley, who pulls off a stunning save! Brighton win a corner.
19' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Daniel Bentley comes off the line to clear the ball away.
17' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
16' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Andre (Wolves) brought his opponent down.

14' What a huge chance for Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
14' Mateus Mane (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul.
9' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' 2 - 0 Maxim De Cuyper sends the resulting corner into the box and expertly finds Lewis Dunk (Brighton), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the roof of the net. It's 2:0.
5' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
5' An attempted cross from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
1' 1 - 0 Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the top right corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
John Brooks was nominated as the referee for this game.
